name: tileforge-studio
tileforgeReleaseNotes: Fold and compact windows use a full-width map with a larger Tiles drawer and a small-screen notice.
Tile filters collapse to give the palette a single scroll area with every tile reachable.
Resizable Android windows support DeX, keyboard changes and fold/unfold without reloading the editor.
Movement has simple passage brushes that preserve height, plus persistent beginner help throughout the studio.
